deadline.value: Fall PhD deadline is December 15 for international and domestic applicants (year inferred for Fall 2027).
deadline.quote: Fall application deadlines are December 15 for both international and domestic students.

gre_subject.value: The subject GRE is not required and does not affect eligibility.
gre_subject.quote: No, the subject GRE is not required for admission and it will not affect your eligibility.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School lists no GRE requirement for Materials Science & Engineering.
gre_general.quote: mse@colorado.edu 303-492-9465 MS, PhD GRE not required Spring: September 15 (MS); Fall: December 15

fee_waiver.value: Qualified international students can request a waiver through the MSE program after completing the application; waivers are extremely limited and not guaranteed.
fee_waiver.quote: Qualified international students may qualify for a fee waiver through a partnership between the MSE program and the international admissions office. | Not all requests for fee waivers will be granted

supervisor.value: Students find a research group and advisor with a funded position by the second semester, not before admission.
supervisor.quote: Finding a research group and advisor with a funded position by the second semester (January 1).

funding.value: PhD students are supported through research or teaching assistantships (salary, tuition waiver, partial health insurance); PhD applicants are automatically considered and details come in the admission letter.
funding.quote: Financial support of PhD students is provided in the form of a research assistantship (RA) and/or teaching assistantship (TA) appointment. | PhD applicants are automatically considered for financial aid and the details will be provided in your admission letter.

entry_route.value: A master's is not needed; apply directly to the PhD with a bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: An MS degree is not required to apply to the PhD program. If you are interested in pursuing a PhD, you must apply to and be admitted directly to the PhD program.

notes: MSE uses the Graduate School default English minimums (listed under All Others).
